calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS dist_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx, sum(closing_value) v
FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (SELECT * FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08'),
d AS (SELECT store_key, product_key FROM w GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT w.etl_loaded_at, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (w.store_key,w.product_key)) k, sum(closing_units) u, sum(closing_value) v, sum(receipts_units) r, sum(adjustment_units) a
FROM w JOIN d USING (store_key, product_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH k AS (SELECT week_ending_date, store_key, product_key FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-01' AND DATE '2026-03-22')
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, k.week_ending_date, count(*) n
FROM k JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key)
GROUP BY ALL HAVING s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE region='West' ) 
ORDER BY 1, 6 LIMIT 200

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-02-23' AS start_date, DATE '2026-03-22' AS end_date),
dedup AS (
    -- one row per store version, product version and week (second load of 8 Mar week repeats rows)
    SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, arg_max(closing_value, etl_loaded_at) AS closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week, params
    WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.week_ending_date, cp.category, SUM(d.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM dedup d
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = d.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = d.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT category, count(*) AS weeks, ROUND(AVG(closing_value),2) AS avg_stock_value
FROM weekly GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
